column12: the stage share is a proxy and it cuts both ways. SEER's 'regional' means spread to regional lymph nodes, which is the trial's cT3N+ arm, but the trial also admits cT4 node-negative disease that SEER would call localized, so this understates. Against that, not every locally advanced rectal patient completes neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy and goes on to adjuvant immunotherapy. A narrower restriction the trial does not impose: it does not select on mismatch repair status

column11: a scaling of the book's pool to the ASTEFANIA population, not an eligibility filter. The count: NICE's resource impact report for technology appraisal TA632, adjuvant trastuzumab emtansine (nice.org.uk/guidance/ta632/resources/resource-impact-report-pdf-8772971293), puts 840 people a year in England eligible for adjuvant T-DM1 with residual invasive disease after neoadjuvant taxane and HER2-targeted therapy, the KATHERINE population whose clinical-stage and preoperative therapy criteria ASTEFANIA repeats (clinicaltrials.gov API v2, NCT04873362, checked 2026-10-28). Scaled by population from the 56,286,961 residents of England at mid-2019 (Office for National Statistics) to the 340,110,988 US residents of 1 July 2024 (Census): 840 x 340,110,988 / 56,286,961 = 5,076 a year. 5,076 / 160,000 = 0.031725. Cross-check: 321,910 new US female breast cancers in 2026 (SEER Cancer Stat Facts) x 13.33% HER2-positive (HR-positive HER2-positive 9.40% and HR-negative HER2-positive 3.93%, SEER Cancer Stat Facts, Female Breast Cancer Subtypes, SEER 21, 2018 to 2022) = 42,908 HER2-positive cancers a year, of which 5,076 is 11.8%
column12: the weakest row in this file. The 840 was read from a search index of the NICE report and the England population is ONS's published mid-2019 estimate; neither nice.org.uk nor ons.gov.uk was reachable from this session. Per head it leans low, since US female breast cancer incidence runs above England's. It leans high for the years ahead: the FDA's 2026-05-15 approval of neoadjuvant trastuzumab deruxtecan on DESTINY-Breast11 (pathological complete response 67.3% against 56.3%) shrinks the residual-disease population by about a quarter where it is used. An annual count serves as the stock because adjuvant therapy runs 14 cycles every three weeks, about ten months

column11: a judgement, set low because the setting already has a new standard. ASTEFANIA adds atezolizumab to T-DM1, the arm DESTINY-Breast05 beat, so a positive readout still leaves the combination behind the new standard for most patients; its place is with patients who cannot take trastuzumab deruxtecan

a judgement set well below the published chain, and the row to argue with. The chain for an immuno-oncology Phase 3 is 0.490 Phase 3 to NDA/BLA (n=98) x 0.984 NDA/BLA to approval (n=62) = 0.482 (BIO/Informa/QLS 2011-2020, Figure 7 page 13; data/pos_transitions.csv). Both randomised tests of atezolizumab in HER2-positive breast cancer found in this session were negative: KATE2, this same T-DM1 combination in advanced disease, was unblinded for futility with progression-free survival hazard ratio 0.82 (95% CI 0.55 to 1.23, p=0.33) and more serious adverse events, 33% against 19% (Emens LA et al., Lancet Oncol 2020;21(10):1283-1295, doi:10.1016/S1470-2045(20)30465-4); IMpassion050, neoadjuvant, showed pathological complete response of 62.4% against 62.7% (Huober J et al., J Clin Oncol 2022;40(25):2946-2956, doi:10.1200/JCO.21.02772) and in its final analysis no significant event-free survival gain, hazard ratio 0.90 (95% CI 0.50 to 1.59) (Huober J et al., ESMO Open 2026, doi:10.1016/j.esmoop.2026.108541). And a US filing after a win would meet a standard that has moved to trastuzumab deruxtecan
